newsitem.title: UK: NWE naphtha ends steady to lower in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE naphtha ends steady to lower in quiet trade.

text.p: NWE naphtha prices ended steady to slightly lower in very quiet physical action as traders held back watching the volatile crude and gasoline.
Nov swaps traded down 50 cents at $216/$217 and Dec also fell 50 cents to $210.50/$211.50, traders said.
NWE cargoes were roughly unchanged at $220 cif.
One Belgian refiner was offering a full range 5,000 tonne cargo around $220-$221, but found no buyers, citing more demand for the higher paraffinic grades from the petchem industry.
A broker said recent strength in NWE gasoline prices may discouraging selling naphtha, but gasoline had not rallied enough to prompt naphtha demand from refiners.
A 30,000 tonne Suez cargo was still believed on offer, but the selling price was unknown, he said.
